title: J--Sources sought maintenance for Nexion2000C
description: Sources Sought  The U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) is conducting market research to determine the availability of qualified businesses capable of providing a maintenance service agreement for a NEXION 2000C Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrophotometer as described in the attached statement of work. This sources sought announcement is not a request for quote or proposal and the Government is not committed to award of a purchase order or contract pursuant to this announcement.  The information resulting from this market research is simply for planning purposes to assist the Government in determining its acquisition strategy.  The Government will not pay for any costs incurred in the preparation of information for responding to this notice.  NAICS code: 811210  Electronic and Precision Equipment repair and maintenance Size Standard $34.0 million  All responsible sources may submit capability statements detailing the ability of their service to meet the statement of work included with this announcement. Please indicate whether you are a small business or large business under this size standard in your response. If a subcontractor is being considered to perform this work, documentation demonstrating the subcontractor¿s capability and preparedness to partner on this procurement must be provided.  Responses to this announcement shall only be accepted through electronic mail addressed to Anthony_berry@ios.doi.gov and must be uploaded and received in their entirety no later than  December 4th  08:00 Pacific time.  EXAMPLE statement of work attached subject to change.
